name: passenger arrival intensity
definition: Rate of passenger-group arrivals to the terminal
source_or_basis: To be varied independently and then coupled to flight schedule

name: aircraft arrival intensity
definition: Rate of aircraft arriving for service
source_or_basis: LIT-006 scenario range

name: passenger arrival lead time
definition: Time from passenger terminal arrival to scheduled departure
source_or_basis: LIT-002 scenario range

name: check-in service time
definition: Service time at check-in counter or kiosk
source_or_basis: Distribution not yet selected

name: security or access service time
definition: Service time at security or access control
source_or_basis: Full screening time without vertiport source; access-control variant Uniform(5 20) s from Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021 as scenario (Claude Task 01 PC-03)

name: pad occupancy time
definition: Exclusive occupation time for a pad movement
source_or_basis: LIT-001 baseline

name: stand turnaround time
definition: Time a stand or gate is held by an eVTOL
source_or_basis: LIT-001 scenarios

name: charging duration
definition: Duration of charging only when state of charge does not cover the next mission (VAR-025); duration declared in the reservation
source_or_basis: Need rule NREL 2023 p 53; reserved duration NUAIR/NASA 2021 p 73; duration undefined because Eve and Joby publish no battery energy charge curve or reserve (Claude Task 01 PC-14 PC-15)

name: number of pads
definition: Available TLOF or operational pads
source_or_basis: EASA PTS-VPT-DSN modular baseline one FATO-TLOF

name: number of stands or gates
definition: Available aircraft positions serving passenger interface
source_or_basis: EASA PTS-VPT-DSN modular baseline one stand

name: number of chargers
definition: Available simultaneous charging positions
source_or_basis: Zero in Phase A; later scenarios informed by FAA NREL charging study

name: passengers per flight
definition: Passenger group matched to one piloted reference eVTOL
source_or_basis: Eve and Joby published piloted capacity

name: aircraft reference geometry
definition: Certified enclosing-circle dimension used in applicable geometric design rules
source_or_basis: Requires aircraft AFM or certified design data

name: charging location
definition: Physical location where charging can occur
source_or_basis: Stand or adjacent dedicated after repositioning (NUAIR/NASA 2021 p 73; EASA PTS C.200(f)); absent = touch-and-go vertistop scenario class without regulatory prohibition (FAA EB 105A p 3; Schweiger and Preis 2022 pp 4-5) (Claude Task 01 PC-15 PC-18)

name: passenger aircraft readiness
definition: True when the chain is complete: aircraft at stand; deboarding complete and passengers clear of airside; required servicing done (charging only if energy rule VAR-025 demands it and never with passengers present); crew declares ready for boarding; every passenger boarded (buckled and ready); passenger mass registered on load sheet; dispatch authorised; departure slot revalidated

name: weight check service time
definition: Service time to register passenger and carry-on mass for the load sheet
source_or_basis: Feldhoff 2022 p 5 assumption 20 s; mandatory because load sheet precedes every flight (ICAO Doc 10121 6.3.2)

name: passenger gate movement times
definition: Walk holding area to gate door; door to aircraft proximity; leaving gate after deboarding
source_or_basis: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 expert values (PAR-022 to PAR-024)

name: dispatch energy threshold
definition: Minimum usable energy to dispatch: taxi + trip + contingency + final reserve (AFM go-around time from landing decision point) + additional if needed + extra
source_or_basis: Structure from Reg. (EU) 2024/1111 UAM.OP.VCA.191(c) and UAM.OP.MVCA.175(b)(7); dispatch rule NREL 2023 p 53; values require AFM data not published for Eve or Joby

name: passenger no-show or late probability
definition: Probability that a booked passenger is absent or late at boarding window
source_or_basis: No vertiport or eVTOL source found; assumed (suposto) 0 in base case and varied in sensitivity

name: late passenger policy
definition: Wait for complete group until STD; depart at slot with empty seats; or rebook to next flight with free seat
source_or_basis: No source establishes behaviour; explicit scenario policies (Claude Task 01 Decision 3)

name: passenger wait to boarding
definition: Passenger terminal arrival to start of that passenger boarding; boarding ends when the passenger is buckled and ready for take-off
source_or_basis: Simulation event timestamps; boarding end event from Preis and Hornung 2022 Table A1 (Claude Task 01 PC-08)

name: eVTOL delay
definition: Queueing and blocking delay before required movement or departure
source_or_basis: Simulation event timestamps

name: passenger LoS threshold
definition: Maximum accepted wait or total terminal time
source_or_basis: No validated vertiport standard identified

name: LoS compliance
definition: Share of passengers satisfying declared LoS proxy
source_or_basis: Compare VAR-012 and total time to VAR-014

name: throughput
definition: Completed passenger eVTOL departures per hour
source_or_basis: Simulation event timestamps

name: resource utilization
definition: Busy time divided by available time for each resource
source_or_basis: Resource logs

name: slot release rule
definition: Policy that admits or reschedules arrivals and departures
source_or_basis: Scheduled baseline informed by FAA UAM ConOps and DECEA; FCFS benchmark
